points.decision: 1857年11月12日英国政府被迫再次暂停《1844年银行特许法》。
points.evidence: The government was forced to suspend the Bank Charter Act 1844 again on November 12.

points.decision: 布坎南认定纸币体系是恐慌根源，决定撤回20美元以下银行券的使用。
points.evidence: President James Buchanan announced that the paper-money system seemed to be the root cause of the Panic and then decided to withdraw the usage of all bank notes under twenty dollars.
